    Check the help information of each function in setup page.

original_test_intent: Inspect the help text for every BIOS setup function to verify version-specific functional correctness, context accuracy and human readability on the actual rendered page.
original_method: An operator navigates every setup function without changing settings, captures the full help pane with menu path/context and compares content and rendering against an approved BIOS-version reference and readability rubric.
manual_activity: Live BIOS navigation and judgment of clipping, context and readability are manual; the agent may OCR or diff operator-supplied captures only as supporting analysis.
required_inputs: BIOS version and full menu/function checklist
safety_requirements: Use read-only navigation and do not save or reset settings.
Do not treat OCR/exported text as proof of visual readability or contextual placement.
Do not judge factual correctness without the approved version-specific reference.
Stop on accidental change, missing page, unreadable capture or unsafe menu; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Build the page checklist, index supplied captures, compare OCR/text against references and flag missing, stale or inconsistent content.
Keep visual judgment and formal verdict with the engineer.
engineer_actions: Navigate and capture every help page with path, function and option context; assess rendering/readability.
Confirm configuration unchanged and issue per-page/final verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The narrative correctly rejects an SSH command as a BIOS GUI inspection method.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only optional offline OCR/text diff on supplied captures, preserving screenshots as the authoritative visual evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The every-function scope and 30/30-minute values remain; no sampled subset is implied.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture every function at a stable language/resolution, key it by full menu path and compare both text semantics and rendered presentation with the approved reference.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact BIOS build and setup UI under review.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, language, resolution and capture-device versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Owner-approved BIOS setup specification and product documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exhaustive inventory, contextual keys and separate semantic/visual checks.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects missing pages, stale option descriptions, truncation, overlap, poor contrast and localization defects.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Versioned page inventory and reference rubric.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OCR can miss visual defects and cannot decide whether undocumented behavior is correct.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define languages and optional pages, but must disclose the exact inventory and cannot claim all functions from a partial sample.
expected_evidence: BIOS identity and complete page checklist

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requires review of each rendered help item for correctness and readability.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The operator workflow is clear; manual UI observation and judgment make it MANUAL ONLY rather than blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Keeps the correct manual boundary and makes evidence completeness auditable.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its exhaustive, versioned, visual-versus-semantic review model.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates optional agent artifact analysis from manual acceptance and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Turns a subjective spot check into a complete path-keyed matrix and prevents OCR from masking clipping, overlap or context errors.
independent_technical_reasoning: Help correctness depends on the active control and BIOS version, while readability depends on actual rendering; both require operator-captured UI context and cannot be established from host commands.
